name: usepilot
description: Pilot: take the controls from your coding agent and edit your UI in the browser. A dev-only design overlay that hands your edits to the agent as plain-CSS intent.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pilot/overlay build && pnpm --filter @pilot/cli build && rm -rf dist cli && cp -R ../overlay/dist ./dist && mkdir cli && cp ../cli/dist/index.js cli/index.js
